summary: Visionary IT leader with 20+ years of experience at Fortune 500 companies, driving SAP strategy, process re‑engineering, and analytics initiatives across global manufacturing and pharmaceutical operations.

experience.title: Head, Information Technology and Information Center
responsibilities: Provide leadership and direction to the GMS Information Center, a team of data scientists and analysts producing high‑value analytics for manufacturing.
Drive strategic initiatives and operational excellence across the IT organization.

experience.title: Director, Supply Chain and Logistics Information Technology
responsibilities: Established supply chain technology direction for a global manufacturing organization.
Created the GMS Information Center to deliver advanced analytics.
Delivered transformational projects: Demand Planning Solution (SAP APO), Supply Planning and Sales & Operations Planning (Kinaxis RapidResponse), Inventory Optimization (Kinaxis RapidResponse).
Led delivery and business analysis teams, re‑engineered business processes, and supported global sales and operations processes.

experience.title: Senior Director, COMET Program

experience.title: Director, SAP Center of Excellence

Reduced compensation costs by nearly $1MM through offshore utilization.
Led deployment of SAP ERP for US pharmaceutical business and key solutions in APAC, Europe, and South America.
Designed and deployed a global SAP template to consolidate the footprint to a single instance.
Managed integration efforts for US and APAC commercial operations.

experience.title: Director, Supply Chain Systems

Provided consultative support for projects in Belgium (APO) and Singapore (R/3).

experience.title: Manager, Commercial and Field Force Systems

Designed training programs for field force personnel.

experience.title: Manager, Service Delivery Systems

experience.title: Manager, Client Services Systems
responsibilities: Implemented marketing and client services applications for global bond operations.
Implemented portfolio accounting system for Global Advisors subsidiary.

experience.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Led implementation of a new cash management system for Prudential treasury operations.

experience.title: PC Coordinator
responsibilities: Provided day‑to‑day support for PC hardware and software for the Prudential Help Desk.
